maps.sampledNote: Positions are sampled {hz} times a second and only while a player is alive, so the field is that time added up rather than a path.
maps.worldKillNote: A kill the world did is not drawn: it comes from nowhere a line can start.
maps.lineupNote: Where the thrower was looking is not drawn: view angles are sampled {hz} times a second.

duel.empty: Hover or focus a duel to see what both players held.
duel.lead: Press to watch it on the stage from {seconds, number} s before.

throw.empty: Hover or select a grenade throw to inspect its lineup command and movement.

heat.eventNote: Each mark stands where its player was at the event; damage counts only the health left.
heat.utilityNote: Each grenade stands where it went off; one that never did is not drawn.

metrics.empty: No round economy was recorded for this match.

opening.title: Opening duels
opening.note: The first opponent kill in each round.

trades.title: Trade kills
trades.note: Opponent kills answered within five seconds.

multi.title: Multi-kills
multi.note: Rounds where one player killed at least two opponents.

utilityDamage.title: Utility damage
utilityDamage.note: Health damage dealt to opponents with utility.

clutches.title: Clutches
clutches.note: Rounds won after being the last player alive against opponents.

board.roundLine: Round {round, number}: {kills, plural, one {# kill} other {# kills}}, {damage} damage
